Before anything can be estimated it has to be read in and reshaped. This topic
covers the workflow a data analysis follows, what makes a dataset *tidy*, and
the `readr` / `readxl` / `dplyr` tools you will use in every later exercise.

## Wrangling with `dplyr`

`dplyr` comes up in every exercise from here on, so there is no separate session
for it — use this list to learn it alongside everything else.

**Read**

-   📖 [R4DS Ch. 5 — Data transformation](https://r4ds.had.co.nz/transform.html#transform)
-   📖 Cheat sheet: [Data transformation with dplyr](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rstudio/cheatsheets/main/data-transformation.pdf)
-   📖 [tidyverse/dplyr](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/)

**Practise**

-   [Working with tibbles](https://rstudio.cloud/learn/primers/2.1)
-   [Isolating data with dplyr](https://rstudio.cloud/learn/primers/2.2)
-   [Deriving information with dplyr](https://rstudio.cloud/learn/primers/2.3)
-   [Filtering observations](https://learnr-examples.shinyapps.io/ex-data-filter/)
-   [Summarising data](https://learnr-examples.shinyapps.io/ex-data-summarise/)

## Visualising with `ggplot2`

Like `dplyr`, `ggplot2` is practised throughout rather than in one session.

**Read**

-   📖 [R4DS Ch. 3 — Data visualisation](https://r4ds.had.co.nz/data-visualisation.html#data-visualisation)
-   📖 Cheat sheet: [Data visualization with ggplot2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rstudio/cheatsheets/main/data-visualization.pdf)

**Practise**

-   [Data visualisation basics](https://rstudio.cloud/learn/primers/1.1) · [Exploratory data analysis](https://rstudio.cloud/learn/primers/3.1)

-   [Scatterplots](https://rstudio.cloud/learn/primers/3.5) · [Overplotting](https://rstudio.cloud/learn/primers/3.7) · [Customising plots](https://rstudio.cloud/learn/primers/3.8)
